title: Two Blind Men Receive Sight
description: Two blind men followed Jesus and cried out, 'Son of David!' After they confessed their faith, Jesus touched their eyes so that they could see, but he commanded them to be silent. Nevertheless, they spread the news. Then Jesus drove a demon out of a mute man, to the amazement of the crowd, while the Pharisees accused him of acting by the power of the ruler of demons.
